sections.title: Topics of Psychology in Education: Qualitative Studies of Developmental Interventions
sections.description: This course is designed to introduce students to innovative approaches to the psychology of education, especially with regard to populations from at-risk contexts, sociocultural dimensions of education, and social-emotional learning.
